name: iact_algol_magic_lst1
label: Algol A-B on MAGIC-I + MAGIC-II + LST-1 at 425 nm: the orbit over ten nights at alternating quadratures
notes: Nights every half period (1.434 d) at the quadratures, clear of the eclipses. Science: an orbital parallax at the percent level for the Algol triple (Hipparcos 36.27 +/- 1.40 mas, 3.9 %; CHARA/MIRC orbit Baron et al. 2012); the B component carries ~8 % of the blue light.
